name: holdfast
description: Self-hosted GitHub backups on Cloudflare: scheduled full git mirrors in R2.

scripts.site:build: cp src/style.css site/public/style.css && cp DEPLOY.md site/public/deploy.md && cp LIMITATIONS.md site/public/limitations.md
scripts.site:dev: npm run site:build && wrangler dev -c site/wrangler.jsonc --port 8790
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site:build && wrangler deploy -c site/wrangler.jsonc
